description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'DestinationList' that displays a list of destination cards, handles empty and loading states, and manages scrolling behavior.

classes.name: DestinationList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders a scrollable grid of destination cards with empty state handling.

methods.name: calcX
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate for a given item index based on the column configuration.

methods.name: calcY
methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for a given item index based on row height.

methods.name: updateThumb
methods.description: Updates the scrollbar thumb size and position based on current scroll offset and total content height.

methods.name: recomputeScroll
methods.description: Recalculates scroll constraints based on the number of items and layout parameters.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handler invoked when a destination card is selected, logging the selected item's title.
